priority_legend.P0: On the critical path, or the reference shape other slices copy.
priority_legend.P1: In scope but not on the critical path.
priority_legend.P2: Polish. Drop first if time is short.

sprints.goal: The template ships working reference slices.
sprints.outcome: make check passes and every slice has tests an agent can copy.

epics.title: Template reference slices
epics.summary: The example code the template ships with. Replace these stories with your own after ./rename.sh.

stories.name: Seeded test endpoint
stories.title: As a template user, I want GET /test to return the seeded test string so that I can see the API reach the database.
acceptance_criteria: Given the seeded database, When I call GET /test, Then it returns the seeded test string.

stories.name: Notes CRUD
stories.title: As an API client, I want to create, read, list, update and delete notes so that the template has a complete reference slice.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid note, When I create, get, list, update and delete it, Then each call succeeds with the matching status code.
Given a blank title, When I create or update a note, Then the API returns 400.
Given a note that does not exist, When I get, update or delete it, Then the API returns 404.

stories.name: In-house messaging
stories.title: As a developer, I want Sender and Publisher to dispatch requests and domain events so that the template needs no MediatR.
acceptance_criteria: Given a registered handler, When Sender sends its request, Then that handler runs.
Given registered event handlers, When Publisher publishes the domain events of an entity, Then each handler runs.

stories.name: Layer dependency rule
stories.title: As a maintainer, I want project references checked against the Clean Architecture dependency rule so that layers cannot leak.
acceptance_criteria: Given the solution, When the architecture tests run, Then each project references only the layers AGENTS.md allows.

epics.title: Operations
epics.summary: What a deployed copy of the template needs to be checked and run.

stories.name: Version endpoint
stories.title: As an operator, I want GET /version to return the running build's version so that a deploy can be checked against the release it should be.
acceptance_criteria: Given the API is running, When I GET /version without credentials, Then it returns 200 with a JSON body whose version field equals the informational version of the CleanTemplate.Api assembly.
Given the API is running, When I GET /version, Then the response has the application/json content type.
stories.evidence: 2 tests passed on 7594026 plus uncommitted changes, 2026-10-23T14:22Z

stories.name: Version request file
stories.title: As a developer, I want a Version.http request file so that I can call GET /version from my editor.
acceptance_criteria: Given the repo, When I open requests/Version/Version.http, Then it declares @host = http://localhost:5001 and holds a GET request for {{host}}/version.
Given the repo, When the tests run, Then a test fails if requests/Version/Version.http lacks that request.
